Discover the Jewel of Athens: Northeast Lake

Location:

Located in Athens, Texas, Northeast Lake is a scenic 13-acre lake surrounded by oak and pine trees. With depths up to 15 feet, this lake provides excellent fishing conditions in a quiet, natural environment.

Fishing Highlights:

  • Fish Stocking: Northeast Lake is well-stocked with both Florida and native bass, as well as bluegill, making it a great spot for anglers of all levels.

  • Catch Potential: The lake routinely produces bass in the 2 to 4-pound range, with larger fish over 5 pounds common. The current record catch is 11.32 pounds.

  • Fishing Access: Bank fishing is available, and members also have access to a 12-foot jon boat for exploring more of the lake.

Lodging:

For family outings, there is an A-frame cabin available for rent that comfortably sleeps up to seven people. This four-bedroom cabin provides an ideal space for groups looking to spend quality time on the water together.

Note on Availability:

Although lodging is temporarily unavailable, Northeast Lake remains a peaceful and enjoyable fishing destination, perfect for a relaxing day or weekend trip.

Requirements

Please harvest all bass 14 inches and under as well as any crappie and catfish



For a comfortable stay, please remember:

• No pets and no smoking inside the cabin to maintain a clean and welcoming environment.

• Members are encouraged to bring their own linens and towels for a more personalized experience.

• We ask that all guests take any trash accumulated during their stay with them upon departure, helping keep this scenic property pristine for future visitors.

Reservation and Check-in Information:

• To reserve the cabin, a one-week notice and a 50% nonrefundable deposit are required.

• Check-in begins at 3:00 PM, and check-out is at 12:00 PM (noon), allowing you to relax and enjoy the lake at your own pace.

Thank you for helping us preserve the beauty and serenity of Northeast Lake!


General Directions

This site is located an hour and 45 minutes east of Dallas and 45 minutes from Tyler.
